q: Dalton's law of partial pressures can be stated as: When the temperature is kept constant, the total pressure of a gas mixture is the ____ of the partial pressures of different gases.
e: Dalton's law of partial pressures can be stated as: When the temperature is kept constant, the total pressure of a gas mixture is the sum of the partial pressures of different gases. Dalton's law adds the partial pressures of gases in a mixture to get the total pressure. Partial pressure is the pressure one gas would exert if it occupied the container alone.

q: Thus, diffusion is the gradual mixing of molecules of one gas with molecules of another by virtue of their ____ properties.
e: Thus, diffusion is the gradual mixing of molecules of one gas with molecules of another by virtue of their kinetic properties. Diffusion is the spreading of gas particles from higher to lower concentration through random motion.
